speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions. To begin our assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the pain affect just one wrist or both?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Septic Arthritis of the Left Wrist (likely Gonococcal)

I note your recent camping trip in Minnesota and sexual activity, which raises concerns for disseminated gonococcal infection. Given the fever, chills, and worsening pain, I need to confirm your joint infection immediately. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, Urine_Nucleic_Acid_Amplification_Test (NAAT), CBC, ESR, CRP.
